collection.title: Ford Focus Estate 1998 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Focus Estate 1998 - 2005 model requires a 22" wiper blade for the drivers and a 19" passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Focus which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
